title: Maxmin And Minmax
body_html:
Maxmin And Minmax

For a zero-sum game $(I,J,g)$, the maxmin is $$ \underline v = \sup_{i \in I} \inf_{j \in J} g(i,j), $$ and the minmax is $$ \overline v = \inf_{j \in J} \sup_{i \in I} g(i,j). $$ The maxmin is the best amount player 1 can guarantee, and the minmax is the least amount player 2 can guarantee as an upper bound on player 1's payoff.
